title: ibatia schreiteri
intro: Ibatia schreiteri, commonly known as the "Coral-root" or "Ibatia", is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, pain, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Ibatia schreiteri include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, and possess vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Ibatia schreiteri include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
